topNews.text: 30 Beluga Whales are Finally Being Rescued After 2 Years Waiting in Shuttered Theme Park
topNews.excerpt: The US and Canadian governments recently approved a plan for the transfer of captive beluga whales which have been stranded for years at a closed theme park. topNews.text: Southeast Asia Nears Malaria Elimination, Down Two-Thirds Since 2010
topNews.excerpt: Early in June, international experts joined leaders from Southeast Asia for a summit in Laos, where they discussed the “last mile” of malaria elimination from the eastern-most sector of the region. Burgeoning economically for decades, Vietnam and Cambodia, but also Laos DPR, have seen malaria transmission fall 67% over the last 15 years. Asia Pacific
